06111.page_note: Seven ASAs tile the county; LEMSA letter: 'no changes to the seven exclusive operating areas during the 2024 reporting period'. RFP for future providers pending (watch). County provider page lists 'Lifeline Medical Transport' but the plan records Lifeline's assets moved to Gold Coast in June 2021.

06001.page_note: EOA (all cities + unincorporated except Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Piedmont, LLNL) moved to AMR West: BOS agreement 7/1/25-6/30/31, 'five year service period commencing on 7/1/2026' (https://www.acgov.org/board/bos_calendar/documents/DocsAgendaReg_06_17_25/HEALTH%20CARE%20SERVICES/Set%20Matter%20Calendar/HCSA_388852.pdf). City FDs Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Piedmont run their own EOAs; LLNL = Alameda County Fire (EMSA Jan 2026). EMSA Jan 2026 still names Falck (pre-start). Held: no source dated after the 7/1/2026 start; map answer (Paramedics Plus, NorCal, Royal) is WRONG.

06065.page_note: EMSA Jan 2026: AMR 7 zones, Riverside Co FD/CAL FIRE (Cove Cities, Indio), Cathedral City FD, Idyllwild FPD, Blythe Ambulance. AMR contract expiration 'June 30, 2026' and extensions denied (idyllwildtowncrier.com/?p=74875, Nov 2023). Post-July-2026 provider unknown; map answer (Idyllwild FPD only) is incomplete.

06077.page_note: BOS 2026-02-10: CENCAL Fire and EMS Authority exclusive emergency ambulance in Zones X and Y, May 1 2026-May 1 2031 (sanjoaquin.gov board news). Other zones per EMSA Jan 2026: Manteca District Ambulance (D), Ripon FPD (E), Escalon Community Ambulance (F). Zone X (Lodi) row still says AMR in EMSA; Zone Y boundaries and any other zones not confirmed. Map answer (Escalon only) incomplete.

06095.page_note: EMSA Jan 2026: Medic Ambulance (county except Vacaville area), Vacaville Fire Dept (Vacaville + surrounding unincorporated). Contract on short extensions; new RFP with a Fairfield/Medic joint bid in progress (dailyrepublic.com), award not confirmed. Travis AFB not named.
